about: Words that say 'one' (or the singular article / classifier that stands for it) per locale. A trans_choice() form for 1 whose English text shows the digit ('1 found nothing.') must keep the digit or say one of these words; otherwise the machine translator has read the sample '1' as something else ('I found nothing.'). Latin-script words must stand alone; other scripts may be part of a longer word (ja 一件, zh 一个, th หนึ่ง, ar واحدة). Read by Plurals::lostOne() (scripts/i18n/I18n.php) and scripts/translate_engine.mjs.
